issues.description: The problem text requires exactly the zoo name and internet address (url) plus the municipality name and its regierungsbezirk, but the provided solution uses SELECT Zoo.*, Gemeinde.* (returning all columns). The template also only selects Zoo.name and Gemeinde.name and lacks the required url and regierungsbezirk columns. This mismatch between the problem specification, the template, and the solution can confuse students about which columns they must select and conflicts with the instruction to output exactly the requested data and no more.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution explicitly select only the required columns (e.g. SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk ...) and update the template to include the required columns and the join condition (WHERE Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel). This aligns all artifacts with the instruction to output exactly the requested fields.
